description: Use this when the user asks about recent deposit/supply activity on AAVE — 'Who has been supplying ETH on Base?', 'Show me recent USDC deposits on Polygon', 'What has address 0x... deposited recently?'. V3 chains use the 'supply' entity; V2 chains use 'deposit' — handled automatically. Returns: supplier address, asset symbol, raw amount, and timestamp. Divide amount by 10^decimals for human-readable value.

first.description: Number of supply events to return (1–100, default 20)

reserveSymbol.description: Optional: filter by asset symbol (e.g. USDC, WETH, WBTC)

name: get_recent_supplies
